archetype: Organic & Earthy (Modified to Cheerful Modern Medical)

primary.description: Green: Health, success, and primary actions like Sell/Checkout.

secondary.description: Light Blue: Calm, clinical trust, used for secondary actions and Buy/Receive sections.

layout_and_spacing.rtl_rules: MUST use dir='rtl' on the root element. Use logical Tailwind properties: ms- (margin-inline-start), me- (margin-inline-end), ps- (padding-inline-start), pe- (padding-inline-end), text-start, text-end. Avoid l/r (left/right) utilities.
layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-50 relative flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Design is strictly a mobile POS interface. Layout must fill vertical space efficiently.

components.button_primary: w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600 text-white rounded-2xl py-4 transition-all active:scale-[0.98] shadow-lg shadow-green-500/25
components.button_secondary: w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-600 text-white rounded-2xl py-4 transition-all active:scale-[0.98] shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/25
components.button_outline: w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-transparent border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-green-500 text-slate-700 rounded-2xl py-4 transition-all active:scale-[0.98]
components.input_field: w-full bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-4 text-slate-900 text-base focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500 focus:border-transparent transition-all shadow-sm placeholder:text-slate-400
components.card: bg-white rounded-3xl p-5 border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]
components.tile: bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 border-2 border-transparent hover:border-green-100 shadow-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 transition-all active:scale-[0.96] text-center

login.layout: Clean white background. Top area holds a modern medical logo (e.g., cross with a leaf). Form centered vertically.
login.action: Large Green Login Button. Below it, a subtle text link: 'تسجيل دخول المذاخر' (Wholesalers Login).

home.layout: Header with Pharmacy Name and subtle logout button. Content is a 2x2 grid (Bento Grid) of 4 large, tap-friendly tiles.

sell_and_buy_scanner.layout: Top 40% of screen: Mocked Camera Viewfinder (black bg with scanner brackets and animated green laser line). Bottom 60%: Sliding bottom sheet containing the cart.
sell_and_buy_scanner.features: Instant add representation (< 2s). Cart items list with quick +/- buttons. Grand total prominently displayed. Checkout button sticks to the bottom. For 'Buy', allow manual price input field per item.

inventory.layout: Header with Search Bar. Scrollable list of medicines with current stock level indicators (red if low, green if good).
inventory.action: Tapping a medicine adds it to 'Current Order'. A floating sticky bottom bar shows 'إنشاء طلبية' (Create Order) leading to a mock WhatsApp/Screenshot confirmation screen.

suppliers_marketplace.layout: E-commerce feed. Filter chips at the top. Grid of medicines offered by wholesalers with prices clearly visible.
suppliers_marketplace.card_style: Product image at top, title, wholesaler name (small), price, and an 'Add to Cart' button.

motion.page_transitions: Framer motion for smooth screen changes. Use x: 50, opacity: 0 to x: 0, opacity: 1 (accounting for RTL direction).
motion.micro_interactions: All buttons and tiles MUST scale down slightly on active/tap (active:scale-95).
motion.sheet_slide: Cart and item details should slide up from bottom like a native mobile bottom sheet.

images.description: Futuristic white pharmacy interior. Use as a blurred background or header background with a heavy white/green gradient overlay for the login screen.
Blister pack on drawer. Use as a thumbnail for generic medicines in the inventory list.
Close-up of pills. Use as product thumbnail in the Suppliers/Wholesalers marketplace.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing their role.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a web-based responsive app mimicking a mobile POS. Wrap the main App in a container with 'max-w-md mx-auto shadow-2xl overflow-hidden min-h-screen' to give it a mobile frame on desktop.
CRITICAL: Set 'dir="rtl"' on the root HTML or body tag.
Install Google Font 'Cairo' for Arabic text rendering. Update tailwind.config.js to include it in the sans font family.
For the barcode scanner on Sell/Buy screens, use a mocked UI: a black rectangle with a pulsing green line and a 'Simulate Scan' button below it to immediately add a mock item to the cart.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, professional medical and UI icons.
Replace all padding/margin left and right utilities (e.g., pl-, pr-, ml-, mr-) with inline-start and inline-end (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-) for strict RTL compliance.
The UI should feel cheerful, fast, and highly legible. Use large text sizes and generous spacing for touch targets.
